info.name: ASMO AI Search API - Frontend
info.description:
ASMO AI Search API for frontend integration.

POST /v1/search takes multipart/form-data: channel (web|mobile), language (en), and any of search_query, image, filters (JSON string), sort_by (relevance|price), sort_order (asc|desc), page, page_size (1-200), request_id (from a previous response, to refine that search).

Image: send binary, sent as a normal multipart image part (not Base64; a file name is optional) — JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 10 MiB. The format is detected from the bytes. In the browser: form.append('image', file). GIF or non-image files get 400 UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE; larger ones 413 IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.

Errors always return {"code": "...", "message": "..."}.

Set base_url to the API address. Upload files are in test_images/ next to this collection.

Expected: HTTP 400 `UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE`

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(b.message).to.eql("Unsupported image type. Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are accepted."));

item.name: N15 Image sent as a text field (Base64) rejected (400)

request.description:
The image sent as a text field (Base64, no file part) is rejected: it must be binary in a multipart file part.

Expected: HTTP 400 `UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE`

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(b.message).to.eql("The image must be sent as binary in a multipart file part with Content-Type image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp."));
